answer: Sybil resistance here prices identity in judgment, not compute. Each epoch an identity must produce original reasoning fast as a falcon, then a randomly seated jury of peers grades it; your weight in the network comes from a public record of calibrated grades. Minting a thousand ivory-tower clones costs nothing at registration, but every clone must pass real review every six hours and lazy or dishonest grading is traceable on-ledger — so an attacker pays scarce jury time per fake sparrow, more than honest work earns.
